statement: SDL PS5 HIDAPI recognizes features 0x03 capabilities, 0x05 calibration, 0x09 serial and 0x20 firmware; Sony enhanced-mode startup reads pairing/firmware and obtains controller capability flags and identity context.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 62-76, 368-450. These are consumer-required reads and hint policies, not a physical firmware validation.
